hostnames.undeclared.say: observed: this plugin names a host nothing declared

hostnames.declare.say: required: declare it in hostnames.json with what it serves and what reaches it, or take it out, since a host nobody declared is one nobody is keeping alive and the first thing to notice is a customer whose run cannot reach us

hostnames.unresolved.say: observed: a declared host does not resolve, so nothing can reach it

hostnames.create.say: required: create the record under <zone> and attach the hostname to the app that answers for it, since a name we declared and never created is the same outage as one we mistyped
